notes.title: Bug Solving Update is now Live
notes.content:
Hello Pixes from our new office. Finally we started to make new updates again.
First of all, sorry for the long time without any updates. We were moving our office into new city, new building and we are going on now. In next couple of days we will share our development blog link. So you could see what could you find next and progress of the all new features.

 In our new update there are only minor changes. Bug fixing of our problematic single bed. There is no more glitch on our bed. Also we found out someproblems like clickable action UI objects and hitting cars with your shopping cart were the problems we solved. We did some serious performance improvements. Keep in touch for the huge updates.

Hints about what next and working in progress:

-3rd person view support
-More dynamic AI and more relationship features. You will be able to see and check your relationship status with any other pixies. 
-Inventory system. (As you all know, our pixies can carry only one objects. With inventory system you could carry a backpack or hand packs to carry more than one objects) Also another improvement is planned to be droping objects any where you want rather than placing only on carts, car baggage or houseyard floor.
-More building elements and finally building our second & third floors.
-New clothes
-More customizable characters
-Dinning places on the city like Burger, Chinesse and calling them into our houses
-Improvement on cooking mechanics to make it more fun way
-Auto speed up while sleeping
-Professions and jobs.
-Mini games playable on PC's and mobile phones. Also game center in Town which you could visit and play some mini video or other sports games like table tennis. 
   are planned next. To be short, you're gonna be enjoyed every new updates.[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33576697/342111c561dadf1864d563a10e39a5280de447c6.jpg[/img]

To solve your problematic single bed problem, please sell your old bed and buy a new single bed. Have a good sleep.

notes.title: Update 0.350 notes
notes.content:
Welcome to our first weekly update. Every week you will see a new feature in Life Game.
We have some new features and changes required by players. Let's see what we have new this week

UPDATE NAME: TAXI expansion update Ver: 0.350

NEW FEATURE
-Calling a Taxi from cell phones to reach some specific destinations in our town which makes getting town easy right now.
-Stopping a taxi while in Town to get back home. (There is no option to go anywhere else in town but you can go anywhere you want with Taxi calling into your house again)
-Using a Taxi baggage to carry the items whe bought in town
-Up to 3 chars can be carried by cabs simultaneously.


MAJOR CHANGES
-Longer day times lesser needs drop which makes game to play more easy
-Stopping game time during build mode, you can freely build your house without bothering your needs
-The characters not used by player lose some need less (less worry about when another character is not under control) but still you need to care about them. This time it is more easier.
-Less fatigue effect when running. (So you can go down on foot too)

MINOR CHANGES
-Fixed disturbing car sound
-Showing 'F' key on HUD for increasing time speed
-Fixed faster time speed when game starts
-Fixed when using single bed, stuck in wall.
-Fixed cell phone sliding issue

Every updates have a possibility to bring some bugs. So don't hessitate to report on community HUB and wait until we solve it before giving a negative review. 
Happy Gaming week. See you on next week. 


Daniel Branch (Tomy Vercekti)

notes.title: Hello pixies
notes.content:
First of all, thank you for your interests in our very first day. This make us encouraged to develop this game more. Let me give you some features of the next update approximately being published in two weeks.

*Transporting into town via Cabs. Calling cabs to visit somewhere. 
*Bikes you can buy, ride and visit the town and inventory spaces

*More raw foods, and barbecue

*Game options

We will add features every weeks or two. So keep in touch and don't hessitate to give us new ideas.

notes.title: Release Date Delayed
notes.content:
Our release date is postponed to 16th November.  Sorry for that! The reason is we want to release the game with the some promised contents to be developed during the early access. Edit: We need more tests on different computers to determine minimum systems requirements correctly. In this content, we are working on

*CARS

-The car shop that you can buy cars
-Improving traffic and pedestrian AI's on the town
-Car driving mechanics (speed, gas quadrant, gas shopping etc.)
-Fixing some bugs with the cars (respawning car option after a crash)
-Making cars more useful (Carrying objects in the baggage, braking lights, headlights, every doors of the cars are openable and actively usable even for passenger seats)
-Car garages. Now every houseyards are going to have garages for your car(s)
-Traffic lights

*SHOPPING
-Furniture store. So that you will be able to shop for furnitures in the town. (In first version we have planned you only have an option to shop only via cell phones or PC's but you will be able to shop arround the town as we release the early access)
-Grocery store. You can shop for raw foods on this store and bring the foods at your home and cook it (Old version only has an option to shop via cell phones or PC's)
-We already mentioned car shopping.


*TUTORIALS
-We are working for both video and in game tutorials to show you how to play
-Some Tutorial titles are Basic controllers, Cooking, Driving, Shopping, Usage of some objects, Needs, Skills

*USEFUL UI ELEMENTS
-We are working to make our game UI more understandable and useful.

*PERFORMANCE
-We are working to improve the system performance of the game to make it work with lower system requirements. Active buildings with dynamic day and night cycles in the game may hit the performance but don't worry. Your game is going to be working in very good performance.



*BUG Fixing and Possible Saved game crashes in the future updates
-You will pay for this game and we don't want players experience disappointing bugs that hit your gameplay experiences even it is going to be an early access.
-There will be many updates and new contents in this game during the early access period and after. We are calculating the all future updates possibilities that may crash your current saved game. We want players to continue their game after any updates. We are working to fix all the possible problems you can face after every updates.
